reason: Elastic Memory uses HiPPO-based online compression to encode history into a fixed-size recurrent state with polynomial-sampling retrieval, beating Memorizing Transformer with 16x less memory on 32k+ context tasks and running faster than Melodi at 4x scale; a long-context memory architecture relevant to inference cost, but evaluated as a model architecture rather than a serving system.
title: Towards Compressive and Scalable Recurrent Memory
